content_sections.heading: MPPGCL Expert Civil Engineer Equivalent to EE (Civil) Job Description
content_sections.text: To supervise and assist with civil works of upcoming 1x660 MW units at ATPS Chachai and STPS Sarni. To provide technical advice to MPPGCL for civil works of existing as well as upcoming units each of 1x660 MW at ATPS Chachai and STPS Sarni, including review of designs and drawings. Daily monitoring of ongoing civil works and suggesting procedural improvements. To assist in execution and monitor compliance of civil works related to applicable environmental norms for thermal power plants. To analyze O&M practices adopted in relation to the civil wing in thermal power stations and provide improvement suggestions. To provide any other expert advice required for capital or O&M civil works of the plants.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration is last pay drawn minus present pension, or Rs. 1.25 lakh, whichever is lesser. Where no pension rules apply, 50% of last monthly pay is treated as pension. Initially for one year Extendable on yearly basis upto 67 years of age

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-certified qualification certificate Experience certificate Proof of DOB Identity Proof Medical board health certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPPGCL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the EOI document from www.mppgcl.mp.gov.in free of cost. Fill the application form in physical form (Annexure III). Attach self-certified qualification certificates, experience certificates, proof of DOB, and ID proof. Send the hard copy in a sealed envelope superscribed 'For engagement of Expert equivalent to EE (Civil)' by registered/speed post to the office address. Make sure it reaches by 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The applicant must be retired from MPPGCL, Central/State Govt, or Public Sector Undertakings from EE (Civil) or equivalent/higher posts.
